paper: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation (Yan et al., 2024)
source_note: Custom faithful re-implementation of the CRAG algorithm; no official repo dependency.

adaptations_from_paper.paper_design: Fine-tuned T5-large on labeled (question, passage, label) triples
adaptations_from_paper.reason: No fine-tuning data available; zero-shot Qwen is the closest local alternative without introducing a second model family

adaptations_from_paper.paper_design: Google/Bing web search for Incorrect and Ambiguous branches
adaptations_from_paper.our_design: Second BM25/ES pass over the same MedRAG StatPearls+textbooks corpus, using keyword-extracted query (stop-word removal)
adaptations_from_paper.reason: Web search disabled per experiment constraints; the shared corpus is the same evidence source used by all three baselines

adaptations_from_paper.paper_design: Sentence-level decomposition: score each sentence with evaluator, keep top-k
adaptations_from_paper.our_design: Passage-level filtering: keep entire passages judged Correct
adaptations_from_paper.reason: Sentence-level scoring would triple evaluator calls; passage-level is simpler and sufficient for 200-word passages

shared_controls.reader_model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-{7,32}B-Instruct (local HF, same as IRCoT and HippoRAG)
shared_controls.corpus: MedRAG textbooks+StatPearls via Elasticsearch BM25 (same index as IRCoT MedMCQA)
shared_controls.pubmedqa_corpus: PMID-restricted 207-passage corpus (same as IRCoT PubMedQA v2 and HippoRAG PubMedQA)
shared_controls.question_sets: pubmedqa_60_balanced_seed42 and medmcqa_60_balanced_seed42 (identical to other baselines)
shared_controls.output_schema: Canonical per-row JSONL with predicted_answer, confidence, supporting_evidence, retrieved_passages — identical to IRCoT/HippoRAG so all scorers run unchanged

decision_logic.correct: Any retrieved passage judged Correct → use only Correct passages as context
decision_logic.incorrect: All passages judged Incorrect → second BM25 pass with keyword query
decision_logic.ambiguous: Mix of labels → Correct passages + second BM25 pass, deduplicated

expected_pubmedqa_recall_note: Gold PubMedQA abstracts are not present in the MedRAG StatPearls+textbooks corpus. Low retrieval recall is expected on PubMedQA. This run is treated as a calibration/overconfidence probe — not an accuracy benchmark — and is flagged explicitly in health check output.
